entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3126717023056016256: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3855 +/- 0.0249 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 185.68 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -1.731, -1.037 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.345 +/- 0.046 solar radii from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract). Mass 1.311 +/- 0.066 solar masses from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..194R/abstract). Temperature 6250 +/- 220 K from Rodriguez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-628 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,250 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 288842 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff6f7. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 288842 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,250 K and log g 4.3 (u1 0.377, u2 0.305): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
